name: Myspace Profile
summary: A user profile page that the owner restyled with pasted CSS: a wallpaper, glitter text, a music player, a Top 8 friends grid and a mirror-selfie photo. Myspace made the page a personal stage.

philosophy.core_thesis: A profile is a bedroom wall: the owner decorates it, and the decoration says who they are.
design_principles: Replace the page ground with a full-bleed wallpaper: a band photo, a pattern or a gradient, fixed at the viewport.
Make boxes semi-transparent: black at 70% opacity with a 1px border in a bright accent such as #FF3399.
Place a profile photo of 170px wide at top left, a name line, a mood line and an 'online now' mark.
Show a Top 8 friends grid of 4 by 2 tiles of 75px by 75px with a name below each tile.
Add an autoplay music player bar of 24px to 40px and a comment wall of stacked photo and text rows.
Set text in 10px to 12px Verdana-like type, and set the headings in a decorative colour or glitter image.
Add a glitter or sparkle GIF as a heading and a blinking cursor trail.
anti_patterns: A uniform template that every user shares
Large, quiet type at 18px or more
Neutral, flat colour with no wallpaper
A single column with no friends grid
Locked layout with no custom code

layout.grid_mechanics: A fixed two-column table of 800px: a left column of 300px for the photo, details and friends, and a right column of 480px for the blog and comments.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 5% to 15% of the page is empty; the gaps are 4px, 8px and 16px.
layout.alignment_rules: Left column items flush left; headings centred in colour bars; the Top 8 grid centred.
layout.container_geometry: Boxes with a 0px to 4px radius, a 1px bright border and a 10px to 16px inner padding.

font_pairings.note: Pacifico is a rounded script for names and glitter headings; Noto Sans stands in for Verdana.
Comic Neue is the open look-alike of Comic Sans MS; Arimo is the Arial look-alike.
A marker display for emo and punk profiles.

hierarchy_rules: Use 11px for body text, 12px bold for box titles and 24px for the name.
Use one bright colour for headings and white for text.
Use bold for names and underline for links.
Show the mood line in italics.

color.palette_structure: A dark or patterned wallpaper, translucent black boxes, one hot accent and the default blue and orange of the template.
color.contrast_rules: White on box black is 17:1; hot pink on black is 6:1; keep body text white and use bright colours for headings and borders.
color.surface_treatment: A fixed wallpaper under boxes of black at 60% to 80% opacity; flat colour title bars.
color.light_and_shadow: No light source; a 1px bright border and a 2px glow on the active box; text may carry a 1px black shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: A bedroom wall of posters under glass: translucent panels over a printed wallpaper.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px solid border in an accent colour; a 2px outset on the template boxes.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A shadow of 2px black on text; no blur on boxes.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Small 16px icons for mail, add friend, comment and block; glitter and star GIFs.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Band and selfie photos with a flash, glitter text, heart and skull clip art, and animated sparkle trails.

motion.transition_physics: GIF sparkles loop at 8 to 12 frames per second; a cursor trail follows the pointer; the music starts at page load; boxes cut in with no easing.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover turns a link from white to hot pink with underline; a tile in Top 8 gets a 2px accent border.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels the closeness of a friend's room: personal, loud and a little vain.

avoid_when: The page needs privacy, safety or calm.
The text is long and the reader needs ease.
The brand needs a clean, adult tone.

modifiers.how: Replace the wallpaper with a white ground, rounded boxes and glossy buttons.
Replace the translucent boxes with a tiled background and a visitor counter.
Keep the photo and the friends grid; remove the wallpaper and the glitter.

pack.why: The pop style of this pack matches the cut-out stickers on a profile.

ground.why: The ground is a dark wallpaper with a few bright spots, as on a custom profile.
